description: More 7th Congressional District Leaders are joining the chorus for Speaker Welch to fill the State Central Committeeman post vacated by Congressman Danny Davis’ retirement. State Representatives Eva-Dina Delgado, Lilian Jiménez, Edgar Gonzalez, Aaron Ortiz (previously announced), and Norma Hernand

title: 7th Congressional District Reps and Latino Caucus Step Up with Welch for 7th District State Central Committeeman — VoteChrisWelch.com
